subject: CAIQ: Entitlement & Key Lifecycle Evidence — Staging Plan
messages:
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
To: Michael Ortiz <m.ortiz@palmerlabs.com>, Laura Chen <security@palmerlabs.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com>, David Kim <david_kim@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 30 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: CAIQ: Entitlement & Key Lifecycle Evidence — Staging Plan

Hi Michael / Laura,

Thanks again for the CAIQ submission window. We completed the first pass of answers and the CSA reviewer has asked for tangible artifacts for a handful of controls where we mapped compensating controls previously. The three areas they want evidence for are: 1) entitlement reviews / account provisioning, 2) KMS key lifecycle / rotation logs, and 3) cross-region data residency (EU) for encrypted backups.

Can you confirm the preferred transfer channel for artifact delivery (secure SFTP, encrypted Drive link, or vendor portal)? We plan to stage a compact evidence bundle (see requested filenames below) and would like to hand off by EOD Wed Aug 31 so their reviewer can ingest Monday of next week.

Requested artifact list (staging):
- caiaq_entitlement_matrix.xlsx — mapping of control IDs to owners and evidence file names
- kms_rotation_policy.pdf — rotation policy + excerpted rotation logs for the last 90 days
- s3_read_logs_sample.txt — anonymized access log sample showing EU-bucket access patterns
- short narrative (1-pg) for the workspace provisioning flow and service accounts used in EU region

Internal owners: Soojin (security trace), David (SRE logs), Marissa (artifact packaging). Michael, if Palmer can provide the EU backup/restore manifest and any attestations around your KMS usage that would close the loop.

Thanks — I want to keep this tight so we don't create rework for the reviewer.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Senior Security Program Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Michael Ortiz <m.ortiz@palmerlabs.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Laura Chen <security@palmerlabs.com>
Date: Sun, 30 Aug 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ: Entitlement & Key Lifecycle Evidence — Staging Plan

Evelyn —

Thanks for the clear list. We can provide the backup manifest and a KMS rotation extract, but a couple quick clarifying points:

- For KMS rotation logs, do you need the full key-material change messages or a filtered rotation audit that shows key ID, rotation timestamp, and operator? We usually redact operator identities for privacy.
- The EU backup/restore manifest contains customer-identifying metadata; is it acceptable to provide a redacted manifest plus a signed attestation from our compliance team that the backups are EU-resident?

We can upload via an SFTP dropbox or share a link to an encrypted Drive folder. The SFTP option is faster for our infra team.

Michael Ortiz
Head of Security Engineering, Palmer Labs
m.ortiz@palmerlabs.com

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com>
To: Michael Ortiz <m.ortiz@palmerlabs.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: David Kim <david_kim@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 31 Aug 2026 08:17:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ: Entitlement & Key Lifecycle Evidence — Staging Plan

On Sun, Aug 30, 2026 at 9:12 AM Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> Thanks again for the CAIQ submission window...

Michael — SFTP works fine for us. For the KMS logs, a filtered rotation audit (key ID, rotation timestamp, and a role-based operator field — e.g., "system:rota-service" or "human:service-owner") is sufficient. If you need to redact full operator email addresses, include a mapping doc that explains redaction patterns.

Our proposed staging plan (owners + deadlines):
- David Kim (SRE): collect and export KMS filtered rotation audit and a 90-day rotation summary — due Tue Aug 31 17:00 PDT. Expected filenames: kms_rotation_policy.pdf (policy excerpt) + kms_rotation_extract.csv
- Marissa Cole (Platform Pb): produce caiaq_entitlement_matrix.xlsx — includes IDs, control mapping, evidence filename, and owner attestations — due Tue Aug 31 12:00 PDT.
- Soojin Lee (Security): assemble the 1-page provisioning narrative and sampling instructions for anonymized S3 logs; coordinate with Michael on acceptable redaction — due Wed Sep 1 09:00 PDT.

Upload instructions: please SFTP to sftp.redwood-secure.com (we will provision a short-lived account), or if you prefer Drive, use the encrypted folder link below and mark files with the exact filenames above. We will produce a small intake checklist to attach to the caiaq_entitlement_matrix.xlsx to make the reviewer handoff easier.

Drive (for Palmer): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cRedwoodCAIQ

I'll open a quick Jira ticket and attach the matrix template so we can track completeness.

— Soojin
Soojin Lee
Security Operations Lead
Redwood Inference

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
To: Michael Ortiz <m.ortiz@palmerlabs.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com>, David Kim <david_kim@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 31 Aug 2026 11:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ: Entitlement & Key Lifecycle Evidence — Staging Plan

Perfect, team — thank you. Quick notes before we close the loop:

- Michael: SFTP account will be created now; expect credentials with a 72-hour TTL. Please label any redacted artifacts with a short README.txt describing fields removed and a contact for reviewer follow-up.
- We will prioritize the KMS extract and entitlement matrix in the intake. If the reviewer asks follow-up, we'll route questions straight to Michael and Laura to minimize back-and-forth.
- If anything slips past the Tue/Wed timebox above, ping me and we'll escalate to the compliance PM.

Action items captured in SEC-4721 (link above). I'll attach the intake checklist and the matrix template after this thread.

Thanks all — aiming to have the complete package uploaded by Wed EOD PST.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Senior Security Program Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: caiaq_entitlement_matrix.xlsx, kms_rotation_policy.pdf, s3_read_logs_sample.txt
